recipe: Pinned BiRefNet-matting: 1024 mask inference resized to unchanged RGB dimensions; canonical eight-bit semantic alpha. Uniform plates retain two-pixel measured chroma refinement (magenta32/green16/blue32 foreground band) with unchanged spread assertion. Reviewed spatial plates require excluded corners and nearest alpha<.002 background at least three pixels from alpha>=.01, semantic contour only. Opaque output retains original RGB; soft edges unmix measured plate. Alpha<8 removed; connected regions retained when containing alpha>=128. Fixed anatomical scale/anchor, no stabilization or interpolation.
